subject.title: [Bug]: Unscheduled reminder guard fires for isolated-session crons + counter lost during compaction

question: Should maintainers adopt or refresh the open fork PR that closes this issue, or create a target-repo replacement for the same source-proven fix?
rationale: The source fix shape is clear, but an exact closing PR exists outside the target repository and maintainers should choose the canonical path before duplicate automation runs.

options.title: Adopt Or Replace Focused Fix
options.body: Use the existing fork PR as source material or open a narrow target-repo replacement with isolated-cron and compaction-counter regression coverage.

options.title: Wait On Fork PR
options.body: Keep this issue paired with the fork PR and wait for the contributor to refresh it into a mergeable OpenClaw path.

options.title: Fold Into Broader Reminder Work
options.body: Defer this exact bug behind broader reminder-guard cleanup, accepting that the current isolated-cron false positive remains open meanwhile.

recommendation.title: Adopt Or Replace Focused Fix
recommendation.body: Use the existing fork PR as source material or open a narrow target-repo replacement with isolated-cron and compaction-counter regression coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: They merged the predecessor reminder-guard fix and recently maintained the current guard/runtime files, making them the strongest available routing owner for adopt-or-replace direction.
